name: decision-project
description: Publisher side. Projects one decision to the distributor that owns the quote, by calling the DISTRIBUTOR's own gateway mapping (POST /decision) with the msr- key they minted for us. Callable with {decision_id} from any flow that writes or changes a decision -- flow 1 (underwriting-evaluate), flow 2 (quote-bind) and flow 11 (referral-decide) each need one `flow` node pointing here. It cannot be a record trigger: records-service only republishes a write that sets completed:true, and none of those flows does.
